items.title: Paramount Skydance (PSKY) Gets EU Clearance For Warner Bros. Discovery Acquisition
items.summary: Paramount Skydance (NasdaqGS:PSKY) has received formal clearance from the European Commission for its acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery. This approval addresses a key regulatory step in Europe after reviews in multiple major jurisdictions. The decision was announced as most global regulatory approvals for the transaction have now been secured. items.title: Paramount CEO says politics fueling Warner Bros. merger battle
items.summary: Paramount CEO David Ellison said Tuesday that the legal battle over his proposed multibillion-dollar takeover of Warner Bros.Ellison's Paramount Skydance agreed late last month to delay its $110 billion merger with Warner Bros. to June 2027 while the US lawsuit seeking to block the deal moves forward.

items.title: Paramount–Warner Bros. Discovery judge sets March 2027 trial date for antitrust fight
items.summary: A federal judge has set a March 2027 trial date for the antitrust challenges to Paramount’s acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery.

items.title: Antitrust Trial Over Paramount-Warner Merger Set for March
items.summary: A California federal judge said Tuesday that the antitrust trial will begin March 2 with an expectation that it will run for 12 court days.  The timeline the judge laid out in a written order is much later than the November 2026 start date Paramount had sought.  California Attorney General  Rob Bonta  had petitioned for an April 2027 start.

items.title: PSKY Beats Q2 Estimates, Raises 2026 Outlook As CEO Stands Firm On $110B WBD Deal — But Stock Slips After-Hours
items.summary: Paramount Skydance reaffirmed plans to close its Warner Bros. Discovery merger even as the deal faces an antitrust challenge.

items.title: Paramount’s Streaming Growth Continues Amid Legal Challenges to Warner Deal
items.summary: Paramount’s streaming service continued to grow in the latest quarter, helping to narrowly offset another sales decline for its television unit.

items.title: WBD Set to Report Q2 Earnings: What's in Store for the Stock?
items.summary: Warner Bros. Discovery heads into Q2 earnings with NBA ad losses, linear-TV declines and deal costs offset by a strong HBO Max content slate.

items.title: Why Paramount might win its case and still run out of time to acquire Warner Bros. Discovery
items.summary: Vince Lombardi once said “We didn’t lose the game; we just ran out of time.” Hollywood has seen this movie before, and only a decade ago.
